details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:951-959, 973-985 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the merge train is off, the override clears `verdict_wait_reason` from `final_ci_merge_pending` to "" and never falls back to `auto_merge_waiting`. `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason` checks the `ai:final-ci-merge-pending` label before auto-merge, so the label hides the auto-merge wait on a labelled, auto-merge-enabled, approved MERGEABLE head.
  WHY: With MERGE_TRAIN_ENABLED=false, that head is dispatched on every sweep tick. This is the G1 no-progress loop again, and the round cap cannot bound it because the cap applies only when head_gate_state is not success. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna said MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said NIT, and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes it is a non-default configuration and not a regression against base. The highest is used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:961-988 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the snapshot sets a `verdict_wait_reason` (for example `auto_merge_waiting`) and `review_sweep_final_ci_state` returns `read_failed` or an empty string, the reason is not cleared. The skip branch excludes only `failure`, so the PR is still skipped instead of failing open.
  WHY: A final-CI read that keeps failing suppresses dispatch and loses the failed-final-CI repair path (G6). That contradicts the issue's fail-open rule, the step comment at lines 941-942 and the README row "Any failed read dispatches as before". No test pins this path. All flagging reviewers said MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined to flag this item: the wait state came from a snapshot that was read successfully, and the agents.d fragment documents the behaviour.
- tests/test_review_sweep_verdict_wait.py:test_failed_marker_post_is_logged_and_retried_next_tick | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The test runs only one tick and asserts `len(_lines(tmp_path, "statuses.log")) >= 1`. It never runs the "next tick" its name promises and does not pin exactly one POST.
  WHY: The test would still pass if the loop POSTed several times or if the next tick stopped re-sending, so the guard on "send first, then mark" is weaker than its name says. Both reviewers said NIT.
- tests/test_review_sweep_verdict_wait.py:test_final_ci_in_flight_on_a_conflicted_head_is_dispatched, test_final_ci_merge_pending_label_is_swept_with_the_train_off | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: No test covers the read_failed fail-open regression. The train-off test pins dispatch of an auto-merge head as the expected behaviour, which entrenches the G1 gap.
  WHY: A future change cannot tell the intended train-off fallback apart from the accidental loss of the auto-merge skip, because tests assert dispatch for both. Source severity: NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "No new per-PR call inside the sweep loop or the stall loop. Use data those loops already hold. If one more read is unavoidable, batch it and document the count in the function header."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh::_rb_judge_verdict_wait_check and scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh::review_sweep_verdict_wait_alert
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The PR adds per-PR GraphQL calls in _rb_judge_verdict_wait_check, which the stall loop calls per PR, and per-alerting-PR calls in review_sweep_verdict_wait_alert. Neither function batches at cycle level. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly did not re-raise this: the counts are documented in the function headers and earlier editor rounds accepted it as remaining risk.
- requirement: "A run is still dispatched when it can change the outcome: ... or a manual dispatch."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, the verdict-wait skip in the PR enumeration loop
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The workflow supports `workflow_dispatch` (lines 86-97), but the verdict-wait checks at lines 952-987 do not distinguish manual from scheduled runs. There is no manual-dispatch bypass.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:lines 951-959 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The train-off override `if [ "${verdict_wait_reason}" = "final_ci_merge_pending" ] && [ "${merge_train_skip_active}" != "true" ]; then verdict_wait_reason=""; fi` clears the reason and does not fall back to `auto_merge_waiting`. `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason` checks the label first, so a labelled MERGEABLE head with auto-merge on and MERGE_TRAIN_ENABLED=false loses its skip unless the final-CI read returns `in_flight` (line 978).
  WHY: Every sweep tick dispatches that head again (the G1 loop, #9984). The round cap applies only when head_gate_state is not success (line 902), and the README row says auto-merge heads are skipped. Fix: recompute `auto_merge_waiting` from `.auto_merge_enabled_at` (about 3 lines). Non-default configuration, not a regression against base.
- tests/test_review_sweep_verdict_wait.py:test_failed_marker_post_is_logged_and_retried_next_tick | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Only one tick runs, and `assert len(_lines(tmp_path, "statuses.log")) >= 1` does not pin the attempt count. Because gh_helpers.sh is sourced (review_autofix_sweep.yml lines 311-312), `gh_retry` is used and exactly one POST is expected.
  WHY: No production failure, but the regression guard is weak. Fix: assert `== 1`, then `_reset_logs`, run a second tick and assert `_sends(tmp_path) == 1` (about 4 lines).
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): set `verdict_wait_reason="auto_merge_waiting"` after the train-off clear at lines 957-959 when `jq -e '.mergeable == "MERGEABLE" and (.auto_merge_enabled_at | type) == "string"'` succeeds (3 lines); tighten the test to exactly one POST plus a second-tick `_sends == 1` check (4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- NOTES, not re-flagged (4 related items):
  - The openai read_failed item at lines 961-985 is not reported: the snapshot was read successfully, and the agents.d fragment documents the behaviour.
  - The per-PR GraphQL read in `_rb_judge_verdict_wait_check` and the blocker reads in `review_sweep_verdict_wait_alert` were accepted as remaining risk.
  - The MERGEABLE guard at line 979 is correct, and the fixture `"mergeable": "MERGEABLE"` matches GitHub.
  - `merge_train_skip_active` (lines 432-435) is used correctly.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:Lines 961-968 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On an approved mergeable head with auto-merge enabled, a transient read failure from `review_sweep_final_ci_state` yields `""`, which passes the `!= "failure"` check.
  WHY: The sweep keeps a stale `verdict_wait_reason` instead of re-evaluating or dispatching, so it may skip PRs that need re-evaluation or CI-failure checks.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:Lines 955-958 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: With the train off, clearing `final_ci_merge_pending` does not fall back to checking auto-merge for `auto_merge_waiting`.
  WHY: Heads with both the label and auto-merge are dispatched on every tick while the train is off, which violates G1.
- tests/test_review_sweep_verdict_wait.py:test_failed_marker_post_is_logged_and_retried_next_tick | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The test only checks that a log entry exists. It does not check the retry count or behaviour across ticks.
  WHY: It passes even if the retry or next-tick re-send logic is broken.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: "No new per-PR call inside the sweep loop or the stall loop. Use data those loops already hold. If one more read is unavoidable, batch it and document the count in the function header."
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh::_rb_judge_verdict_wait_check and scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh::review_sweep_verdict_wait_alert
  Evidence of absence: Per-PR GraphQL calls in _rb_judge_verdict_wait_check (stall loop) and per-alerting-PR calls in review_sweep_verdict_wait_alert, with no cycle-level batching.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:lines 955-959 (the train-off override block introduced by this run) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The override clears `final_ci_merge_pending` without recomputing the reason. `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason` checks the label first, so a head that has the label and auto-merge is dispatched even though it is in the `auto_merge_waiting` state.
  WHY: With MERGE_TRAIN_ENABLED=false, every tick spends a runner on that head without changing the verdict, which re-introduces the loop #9991 meant to stop. test_final_ci_merge_pending_label_is_swept_with_the_train_off has no auto_at, so no test covers this case.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:line 968 (the [ "${approved_final_ci}" != "failure" ] guard) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `review_sweep_final_ci_state` returns `read_failed` on an approved MERGEABLE head whose snapshot says `auto_merge_waiting`, the skip fires instead of failing open.
  WHY: A transient final-CI read failure suppresses dispatch. Any state other than the exact string "failure", including read_failed and an empty string, lets the skip fire.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:957-959, 973-985 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: With the train off, the workflow clears `final_ci_merge_pending` without checking auto-merge. The label is checked before auto-merge, so it masks the auto-merge waiting state.
  WHY: A mergeable, approved PR with both the label and auto-merge is dispatched on every tick while the train is off. The train does not remove the label in that configuration, and the later in-flight check does not restore the reason.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:961-985 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: If `review_sweep_final_ci_state` returns `read_failed` on an approved auto-merge head, the `auto_merge_waiting` reason stays. The skip excludes only `failure`, so the PR is still skipped.
  WHY: A failed final-CI read suppresses dispatch instead of failing open as before, so the sweep can miss failed-final-CI handling.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: "A run is still dispatched when it can change the outcome: ... or a manual dispatch."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, the verdict-wait skip in the PR enumeration loop.
  Evidence of absence: `workflow_dispatch` is supported (lines 86-97), but the verdict-wait checks at lines 952-987 do not distinguish manual from scheduled runs, and no manual-dispatch bypass exists.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
